title: KBD adopted completion contract
description: Versioned finite completion contract for one useful runnable end-to-end KBD phase. Authored during Spec/Plan, frozen before production implementation, and adopted through the existing canonical writer (prometheus kbd decision record, via scripts/kbd-contract-adopt.mjs) carrying path + SHA-256 digest + plan revision. Amendments are new canonical decisions with supersedes lineage; stale digests are rejected by the readiness checker (scripts/kbd-phase-readiness-check.mjs).

contractVersion.description: Contract format version, e.g. "1". Bumped only by an amendment decision.

runId.description: Canonical run id from prometheus kbd status.

phaseId.description: Canonical phase id (kebab-case directory name under .kbd-orchestrator/phases/).

planRevision.description: Stamped by the adoption writer from canonical status at adoption time. Excluded from the digest; the canonical Decision binds plan_revision itself. Traceability metadata, not an equality gate.

contractDigest.description: Stamped by the adoption writer AFTER digest computation. Excluded from the digest input to avoid self-referential recursion.

command.description: Exact normalization used by BOTH writer and checker. In mini: lib/kbd/adopted-contract.mjs stableStringify(digestPayload(contract)) — recursively key-sorted compact JSON with identity.contractDigest and identity.planRevision deleted, hashed with node:crypto sha256 (the jq -S -c equivalent; no jq/shell dependency).

stalenessRule.description: Deterministic rule deciding REJECT-STALE, e.g. digest mismatch vs latest non-superseded adoption decision for this contract path.

adoptionSource.description: Explicit operator instruction reference. Never inferred from TODOs or reflections.

amendmentPolicy.description: Material scope/acceptance changes require explicit operator version-adoption recorded as a new canonical decision with supersedes; suggestions never auto-enter task totals.

userOperation.description: The real user operation this phase delivers.

currentCapabilities.description: Honest capability statement from code/capability inventory — never task counts.

statusVocabulary.description: Exactly the four verdict classes. Unknown is neither success nor observed failure.

scenarioMatrix.description: Finite adopted acceptance set. Scenario IDs are stable and frozen before implementation.

ownerTask.description: Owning task ID(s) from tasks.json, e.g. "T4+T5+T7".

productionEntry.description: Shipped script/CLI path and exact invocation.

negativeControl.description: The run that must NOT pass, proving the oracle discriminates.

fixtures.description: Fixture identity: scratch roots, content digests, isolation guarantees.

evidence.description: Required recorded evidence: argv, exit codes, stdout/stderr excerpts, digests.

classification.description: Optional: marks delivery/packaging-only validation so its failure is never cascaded into product-failure claims.

policy.description: Adopted requirements never defer via budget overflow (exhaustion => checkpoint+BLOCKED); only never-adopted optional items may defer.

requiredSafetyChecks.description: Non-waivable checks. Never silently dropped, never downgraded by repair-budget exhaustion.

tokenBudget.description: Measured value or the literal "UNKNOWN" with tokenFallback recorded.

exhaustion.description: checkpoint + BLOCKED; never silent PASS; docs/state may be saved without running product tests.

extensions.description: Approved amendments. A numeric field is an ADDITIVE allowance; an object field selects the operation explicitly ('add' | 'replace' | 'unchanged') so an additive time/tool extension can never silently double an unchanged no-progress threshold. The latest extension carrying explicit resultingCeilings replaces the running totals; consumption history is never reset.

evidenceInvalidation.description: Digest/revision/fixture-keyed invalidation; only affected evidence is invalidated; history preserved; no blanket re-review.

postImplementationOnly.description: Boundary verification runs only after complete production implementation; no per-task test loops.

commands.description: Exact argv strings, run once, in order.

implementationComplete.description: false at adoption; flipping to true is a content change requiring an amendment decision (new digest, supersedes).
